note: Nothing here is added until somebody presses a button. Which companies you watch is the most telling thing in this app, so Cairn arrives watching none of them -- what it carries is a list of boards it knows are real, offered on the Employers screen so a first run has somewhere to fetch from. Adding one records it in your vault; removing it takes it out. The list is identical for everybody, so it says nothing about you until you change it.
howToAdd: Open a company's careers page, copy the URL of any job on it, and paste it into Sources -> Employers. A URL like https://boards.greenhouse.io/EXAMPLE/jobs/1234 gives the token EXAMPLE.
